messages.author: 02d84e2501be4973
messages.subject: Factor to numeric
parts:
Hi all,

Below are address coordinates, I obtained from Google. However the
longitudes y3$long and the latitudes y3$lat have a mode “numeric” and
a class “factor”. I obtained them after this transformation:
as.vector(as.character(unlist())) of the geocoded addresses.
How could I change the class from factor to numeric while keeping the
decimal digits?
FAQ 7.10 in R-project would not work as it seems to be designed for
integer numbers.
Using format() will change the class into “character” and from
“Character” to "numeric" the decimal digits were dropped. thank for
any advice.
Ndiaye
> y3
lat long
1 43.0620710 -89.4008460
2 43.1143500 -89.6552100
3 43.1675050 -89.0641150
4 42.9854970 -89.5334110
5 42.9854970 -89.5334110
(truncated)

messages.author: c91a208fffacfb7e
messages.subject: Re: Factor to numeric
parts:
Are you sure that the decimal digits were dropped or was it just that
when they were printed there was truncation. One of the options
settings is "digits" which is 7 when you start R. If you want to get
numbers printed out to a greater number of significant digits then
change that option as, say

options(digits = 14)

You will likely find that the full numeric precision was retained.
